caseNameFull: Campbell, Commissioner of Agriculture of Georgia v. Hussey
attorneys: Eugene Cook, Attorney General of Georgia, C. Hughel Harrison, Assistant Attorney General, and Gordon Knox, Frank S. Twitty and Chris B. Conyers, Deputy Assistant Attorneys General, for Commissioner of Agriculture, and Denmark Groover, Jr. for Georgia Farm Bureau Federation, appellants.

opinions.text: Appeal from the United States District Court for the Southern District of Georgia. Probable jurisdiction noted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief setting forth the views of the United States.
